title: Turn coverage.enforce on with a baseline CI can reproduce
goal: coverage.enforce true against a baseline measured in CI's environment
acceptance: The committed baseline matches what CI measures (written from a CI run, or the local-only tests named and excluded)
`coverage.enforce` is true and CI's coverage table passes
privacy: Neutral invented fixtures only; no personal data, credentials or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-26 after #120 failed: CI measures functions 86.2 % where a local run measures 89.7 % on the same code (CI skips a test local runs execute), so a locally written baseline fails CI by more than 2 points. Estimate, not a measurement.
